about: Published opening hours for registry places, researched 2026-10-10 from each operator's own website (no third-party sources). Hours apply only inside the listed periods; dates outside them are treated as unknown. Day values: "HH:MM-HH:MM" (comma-separated for split hours), "HH:MM-late" (closing time not published), "open 24h", "closed", "unknown" (the source does not say). Spot-checked against the source pages on 2026-10-10: Neues Museum, Charlottenburg Palace, Restaurant Tim Raue.
